description: This file contains platform-specific functions related to managing file descriptor sets and socket operations within the libwebsockets library for FreeRTOS. It provides functions to insert, delete, and change pollfd structures associated with websocket instances, as well as a function to insert websocket instances into a lookup table.

methods.name: void lws_plat_insert_socket_into_fds(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Inserts a websocket instance into the thread's file descriptor set.

methods.name: void lws_plat_delete_socket_from_fds(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,int m)
methods.description: Removes a websocket instance from the thread's file descriptor set.

methods.name: int lws_plat_change_pollfd(struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pfd)
methods.description: Stub function intended to modify pollfd settings for a websocket instance.

methods.name: int insert_wsi(const struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Inserts a websocket instance into the context's lookup table based on the socket file descriptor.

ctags.name: lws_plat_change_pollfd
ctags.signature: (struct lws_context * context,struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pfd)
